canonical_instance.instance_rule: Resolve the canonical world POI by world_id + poi_id + A1 cell; A0 supplies the persistent instance identity. A8 does not mint or persist a second identity.

a8_scene.mount_transform: A0 resolves and mounts the compact shell from the A1 cell; the 960x600 worksite is entered only through the typed doorway request and its local spawn is never a world position.

actions.intent: Commit the east route state only after A3 approves its oak_wood debit; collision/blocker projection follows committed owner state.
actions.authorization: BLOCKED: item ID exists in current A3 PR19, but no approved price for this Quarry action.

actions.intent: Commit the west route state only after A3 approves its stone_chunk debit; collision/blocker projection follows committed owner state.
actions.authorization: BLOCKED: item ID exists in current A3 PR19, but no approved price for this Quarry action.

actions.intent: Persist the safe leave choice without an item transaction; it must not unlock extraction.
A0-owned atomic source claim after the committed safe route; debit/claim/world-state/owner cooldown commit together.
actions.authorization: BLOCKED: A3 PR19 source is generic and not bound to poi_crown_south_quarry; A3 must authorize its site mapping and balance before any grant.

a0.entrypoint: A0-owned adapter using the existing SaveService.transact_once boundary; current A0 head has no A8 POI adapter.
owner_validates: canonical physical instance resolves to one A1 POI
scene/harness source flags are not accepted as authority
actor remains in range, at the authored stand, and faces the socket at commit
A3 item/source definitions and explicit action authorization are current
once-only claim or owner-derived replenishment generation
transaction receipt and site state update atomically
a0.failure_semantics: Reject with unchanged owner projection; interrupted pre-commit retry reuses the same owner-derived claim identity; no local Boolean may suppress a later valid claim.

required_source_mapping.stone_chunk: live_stone_chunk -> poi_crown_south_quarry, subject to A3 approval

required_decisions: approve or reject both route-action cost quantities
approve or reject the Quarry stone_chunk reward quantity and replenishment interval
set approved balance/source status and site binding in the A3-owned catalog

a1_a0_mount.required: A0 mounts the single PackedScene at the exact A1 POI cell through the current world transform; A1/A0 confirm the native collision/route alignment before exposure.

persistence_projection.required_save_domain: save.survival.world_pois (A0-owned schema/migration required; not present in current A0 sanitize contract)

resource_ready_at.south_seam_outcrop: A0 owner clock/timestamp, set only on committed extraction

per_instance_fields.capabilities: A0 player progression projection; never persisted by the scene
per_instance_fields.projection_revision: A0-monotonic revision for stale intent rejection

persistence_projection.atomicity: A0 must mutate cost/reward, claim receipt, generation/cooldown, route state and projection revision in the same SaveService.transact_once candidate.

fixture_values_policy: Existing amounts and cooldowns in site JSON and PoiAuthorityFixture are test inputs only. They are not A3-approved prices, yields, loot rates, grants, or production state. Production adapters must ignore/reject provisional_test_only intents until A3 authorization exists.

a3_binding_review.source_identity_and_prices: No A8 site binding or action price exists; all A8 candidate costs, yields and cooldowns remain proposal-only fixture inputs.
